about_short_description.short_description: Archbee is a product documentation platform that provides a docs tool for software teams and products.

product.name: Knowledge Portal Platform
product.description: A platform for creating, managing, and publishing knowledge portals that organize and deliver documentation for teams and customers.

product.name: AI-Powered Instant Answering
product.description: An AI feature that provides instant answers to user questions based on the documentation content.

product.name: Collaborative Documentation Tools
product.description: Tools for writing, reviewing, and organizing documentation collaboratively in real time.

product.name: Content Management at Scale
product.description: Features to manage large and growing documentation sets using variables, reusable snippets, display rules, and AI translations.

product.name: Publishing and Sharing Options
product.description: Capabilities to publish knowledge portals on custom domains, embed them in apps, and control access with user authentication.

product.name: Integrations with External Tools
product.description: Integration capabilities with over 1800 tools to connect Archbee with existing workflows and systems.
